_comment: Typical Australian masonry unit sizes and characteristic unconfined
compressive strengths f'uc, for AS 3700:2018 Section 3.
This is REFERENCE DATA (ASET component 1) and is UNVERIFIED in the same
sense as every other table in this package: it is recalled from typical
manufacturer literature and general practice, not transcribed from a
specific supplier's current published data sheet or a site-specific test
report. f'uc in particular varies by manufacturer and product line even
within one nominal series -- confirm the ACTUAL f'uc for the specified
unit before using anything derived from this table for an issued design.
work_size is the nominal (length, height, thickness) a unit is specified
by, mm. thickness is what governs wall thickness and Zd in this package's
source: Typical values, general concrete/clay masonry industry literature -- not a specific manufacturer data sheet
